notes.title: Update report 2019-10-12
notes.content:
Update items:

* Added to clear the display stand for merchandise.
When you choose to place the merchandise on the display stand,
Use the middle mouse button to click to set the small box of the product.
You can clear the placed items.

* Repair plus money and super chef secrets can be normal
(The secret technique is the same as the Bakery)

* Player returns Special Products 12 Achievements cannot be achieved,
But after checking, it is confirmed to be normal.
(The product is a tea egg,
This achievement can be obtained after the development is completed)

Thank you for your return.
